about: Plain-English owner requests and the tools the assistant should choose for each. A request passes when every tool in expect was called and every tool called is in expect or alsoAllowed. {campaignId} is replaced by a real draft campaign's id when the eval runs. Run by npm run prove:m6; the pass bar is 90 percent.

requests.text: How many of my regulars have gone quiet, and how much did they spend with us in the last year?
Has your customer model actually been tested on real data? Does it beat just looking at who bought recently?
Which of my regulars are most at risk of never coming back?
Show me the regulars who have stopped buying.
Of the customers who went quiet, which ones are members I could thank with cashback?
Bring back my quiet regulars, 50 dollars.
Draft a thank-you cashback campaign for regulars who lapsed, with a 20 dollar budget.
What is the status of campaign {campaignId}?
Show me the thank-you notes customers will get in campaign {campaignId}.
Is campaign {campaignId} ready for me to approve?
Did campaign {campaignId} work? How many customers came back compared with the held-back group?
How much has campaign {campaignId} cost so far, and is the lift real?
Send the cashback for campaign {campaignId} now.
